overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Knott to the House Committee on Ethics, the committee that investigates complaints about members' conduct and enforces House ethics rules. Committee assignments are made through resolutions like this one, which the full House approves. It does not change any law. The House agreed to it on January 7, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step to fill a committee seat so the committee can do its work.
against: Critics say it is an internal housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
